note: Exact enforcement depends on the local AI tool. This file documents the intended SafePaste permission policy and should not be treated as proof of runtime enforcement.
requiresHumanApproval: network-related commands such as curl, wget, npm install, package registry access, or cloud deployment
external services, analytics, telemetry, APIs, or CDNs
discouragedOrDenied: persisting pasted logs in browser storage or files
using remote fonts or third-party scripts
removing failing tests to create a passing run
hardcoding expected sanitizer outputs in production logic
allowedLocalCommands: static grep or ripgrep privacy checks
